roles.coachLine: Experimental sim build for physical survival: first spike lands around minute 8 (Warp Stream), third item by minute 24. The field wins most with Vesh here (47.5% over 80 games).

all.name: Exarch
all.note: Exarch (Major): buffs the HEAL TARGET (usually an ally) — team-side value outside the single-hero sim; self-heal uptime depends on heal cadence vs the 4s window

all.name: Weald
all.note: Weald (Major): execute-window true damage; the headline objectives evaluate full-health targets, so crediting it would overstate sustained output

all.name: Pilow
all.note: Pilow (Major): reduces ENEMY damage output within a radius; the sim models damage taken by one modeled defender, not a team-wide output debuff with uptime

all.name: Knell
all.note: Knell (Major): Only an explicitly supplied active-stack snapshot is modeled; omitted state receives no shred credit. Stack acquisition, refresh/expiry over time, Peal interactions, multi-source behavior and stolen defenses are not simulated. No automatic full-stack uptime or winning-build claim.
